name: Good Deeds To Go To Heaven
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that no amount of good deeds or human righteousness can secure entrance into heaven, as all have sinned and fall short of God's glory, and our righteousness is like filthy rags (Isaiah 64:6; Romans 3:23). The wages of sin is death, but God offers the gift of eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ, who is the only way to the Father (Romans 6:23; John 14:6). Salvation is received by confessing Jesus as Lord and believing in His resurrection, not by works, underscoring that heaven is accessed through grace alone (Romans 10:9; John 3:16).
